title: Locale aware
text: Parses and formats group and decimal separators, locale digits, and minus signs for each locale.

title: Currency, percent, units
text: Display formats from Intl.NumberFormat, while the submitted value stays canonical.

title: Stepping
text: Arrow keys and optional stepper buttons move the value by the configured step.

title: Range validation
text: Minimum, maximum, and step checks with localized messages.

title: Accessible spinbutton
text: Exposes the spinbutton role instead of the inconsistent native number input.
